vergea.e: Inherited from Late Latin virgella, diminutive of Latin virgula, itself a diminutive of virga. Compare Aromanian virdzeauã.

căpistere.e: Inherited from Latin capisterium, probably through a Vulgar Latin *capisteria. The Latin further derives from Ancient Greek σκαφιστήριον (skaphistḗrion). Compare Tuscan Italian capistejo, capisteo, Abruzzese Neapolitan capistiera.
